skills.name: Shield Slam (Gale)
skills.description:
Strike an enemy with your shield, dealing 537 (474 + 51% Melee Attack) Physical Damage. Interrupts the target, canceling all Cast Time, Channeled, and Ongoing skills.
This skill has a dramatically shorter Cooldown than regular Shield Slam, but deals less damage and does not Stun.

skills.name: Bull Rush
skills.description:
Ram the enemy with a disruptive shield attack, inflicting 907 (741 + 133% Melee Attack) Physical Damage and Silencing the target for 5.8s. 
Interrupts the target, canceling all Cast Time, Channeled, and Ongoing skills.
Increases Aggro generation +200% for 5 seconds afterwards.

skills.name: Ollo's Hammer
skills.description:
Summons Ollo's hammer and hurls it toward a location; inflicts Trip on an enemy for 2.5s if it hits.
Also deals 1011 (716 + 236% Melee Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies within 3m of the target location.

ranks.label: Rank 1
ranks.description:
Summons Ollo's hammer and hurls it toward a location; inflicts Trip on an enemy for 2.5s if it hits.
Also deals 1011 (716 + 236% Melee Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies within 3m of the target location.

skills.name: Revitalizing Cheer
skills.description:
Restores +617 Health plus an amount equal to 50% of your stacked Mettle.
Consumes all stacked Mettle and cures one debuff.

ranks.label: Rank 1
ranks.description:
Restores +617 Health plus an amount equal to 50% of your stacked Mettle.
Consumes all stacked Mettle and cures one debuff.

skills.gcdNote: No GCD (off-GCD instant self-heal; usable during GCD)

skills.name: Hollow Ollo's Hammer
skills.description:
Enlightened Hollow Defense Mark: Summons Ollo's Shield and hurls it toward a target location, dealing Physical Damage within 3m and inflicting Disarm for 3s.
Once the shield lands, emanates a protective shield every second absorbing up to 3,000 damage for nearby allies.

ranks.label: Rank 1
ranks.description: Enlightened Hollow Defense Mark: Hurls Ollo's Shield, dealing Physical Damage within 3m, Disarming enemies for 3s, and emanating a 3,000-damage shield every second for allies.

skills.name: Mocking Howl
skills.utilitySummary: AoE Distressed (6s: -60% Heal, triggers Distressed combos)
skills.description: Provokes nearby enemies and inflicts Distressed for 6.0s (-60% Received Healing, -20% Skill Damage, enables Precision Strike / Shadowsmite / Skewer Distressed combos).

skills.name: Imprison
skills.description: Raises a stone prison wall around the area for 14s, trapping enemies inside.

skills.name: Fortress
skills.description: Shoves away up to 5 enemies within 10m regardless of status, pulls 5 raid members closer (-50% received damage), and grants +1,500 Mettle.

skills.name: Boastful Roar
skills.description:
Inflicts Distressed for 7s, reducing the enemy's Move Speed -45%, Skill Damage -20%, Attack Speed -250, and healing effectiveness -60%.
Inflicts additional Magic Damage equal to 60% of your stacked Mettle, consuming all stacks of Mettle when cast.
Also Provokes the target for 4s.

ranks.label: Rank 1
ranks.description: Inflicts Distressed for 7s (-60% Received Healing, -20% Skill Damage, -250 Attack Speed, -45% Move Speed) and deals Magic Damage equal to 60% of your stacked Mettle, consuming all Mettle.

skills.name: Imprison (Wave)
skills.description:
Summons a magical circle for 8 seconds that allows anyone to enter but prevents them from escaping.
Enemies can break out if they use enough force. Only applies in PvP.

skills.name: Imprison (Mist)
skills.description:
Summons a 20m wide wall of mist directly in front of you. The wall remains in place for 12 seconds.
Enemies can break through if they use enough force.

skills.name: Cruel Binding
skills.description:
Tethers an enemy's soul to a location for 4s, pulling them back to that spot every time they attempt to move further than 10m away.
Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration.

skills.name: Shield Throw
skills.description:
Hurls your shield at the target, dealing 189 (180 + 100% Melee Attack) Physical Damage.
Has a 100% chance to Critical Strike. Temporarily removes all benefits of your shield while the projectile is in the air. Inflicts Disarm on targets that Parry the attack, removing all benefits of their weapon for 6s.
At Rank 2, bounces on impact, striking up to 3 additional nearby targets.

ranks.label: Rank 1
ranks.description: Hurls your shield at the target, dealing 189 (180 + 100% Melee Attack) Physical Damage with a 100% chance to Critical Strike. Disarms targets that Parry for 6s.

skills.name: Redoubt (Gale)
skills.description: Raises a shield around the caster for 6s. Increases Block Rate +38% and decreases Move Speed -10%. Instantly grants Mettle and prevents being Pushed or Tripped. Requires a shield.

skills.name: Redoubt (Life)
skills.description: Strengthens the caster's defenses for 20s. Increases Physical Defense +40% and decreases Move Speed -10%. Instantly grants Mettle and prevents being Pushed or Tripped.
